items:
Welcome to 3 By the Sea + You & Me, a classic 6-bedroom, 6-bathroom vacation home nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Just 500 feet from the sand, this spacious retreat offers everything you need for a memorable beach getaway, with room for up to 16 guests across three beautifully appointed levels.

Inside, the open main living area features bright coastal décor, abundant natural light, and comfortable seating for the whole group. The chef’s kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, and a large island—perfect for shared meals or evening cocktails.

Each level offers space and privacy, with three king suites, a double-queen room, a bunk room with two twin over twin bunks, and multiple en-suite bathrooms. A second floor game room and additional gathering space make it easy for multiple families to enjoy time together—or apart.

Step outside to your private pool (heating available for an additional fee), or head up to the rooftop deck to enjoy gulf breezes and sunsets. The home also includes a gas grill, washer/dryer, ample parking, and outdoor shower.

Located just off Scenic 30A, you’ll have easy access to nearby dining, shopping, and bike paths, plus the charm of Seaside, WaterColor, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away. Seagrove makes beach days effortless with multiple public and neighborhood access points dotted along 30A. Within just a few minutes, you can reach regional beach entrances with restrooms and parking as well as quiet walkovers tucked between classic Seagrove cottages. Guests can choose the closest path for a quick walk to the sand or cruise by bike/golf cart to larger Gulf-front access points—easy, flexible, and perfect for families.

-Home Highlights:
-Sleeps 16 comfortably
-3 King Suites with En-Suite Bathrooms
-1 Room with 2 Queen Beds
-1 Queen Bedroom with Shared Bathroom
-Bunk Room with 2 Twin/Twin Bunks
-Private Pool (heating optional)
-Rooftop Deck with Seating
-Fully Equipped Kitchen
-2 Living Areas + TVs in Each Bedroom
-500 ft to Beach Access
-Gas Grill & Outdoor Shower
-Washer/Dryer & Ample Parking
